problem: Canonical DFT input hash mismatch. The task pinned SHA-256 b92d203fa6f152120a316b9e32c037f7c1c978e96424edf5a871f02e5cfe0fd4 for project/DALI/input/DFT.csv, but the file on disk hashes to c87e601534d5d4cacea3a68793585473874cf541c44c4e10b68f1dd34485a5c5. The on-disk file is also not CSV text: it is a binary container (magic bytes 54 53 5a 23 = 'TSZ#', NUL bytes present, 54.3% non-ASCII/control bytes), so it cannot be the parsed DFT workbook export that the pinned hash implies.
impact: The DFT derivation could not be trusted for any downstream consumer. Per the dispatched stop condition, no metadata was derived: team/artifacts/tm109-direct-trial/dft/dft-meta.json was deliberately NOT created. test-strategy-architect remains blocked because its mandatory DFT input for TM109 is unresolved.

evidence.confirmedBy: two independent tools agreeing: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 and certutil -hashfile SHA256

evidence.observed: The project's own authoritative manifest declares its DFT source as project\DALI\Dali_testmode.xlsx (10677032 bytes, sha256 0b0480a290581fd3d10ec9db7aef45664949174bb8f1a94e926f24cfa582abbd, 22 sheets). It contains no record of DFT.csv and no record of hash b92d203f, so the pinned path/hash cannot be corroborated from project evidence.

alternativesEliminated: Not a line-ending or encoding artifact: LF normalization, BOM-stripped, UTF-8 with BOM re-encoded, and UTF-16LE re-encoded variants hash to 724a0347..., c87e6015..., 85a0555b..., and 7a0929aa... respectively; none equals b92d203f...
Not a hashing-tool discrepancy: Get-FileHash and certutil independently report the identical c87e6015... value.

Not a wrong-file-at-wrong-path case within the workspace: a recursive search for DFT*.csv under ATE-Coding-Plat returns exactly two files, DFT.csv (c87e6015...) and DFT_restored.csv (757924e3..., 16824 bytes); neither matches the pinned hash.
Not a truncation or empty-file artifact: the file is 16862 bytes and readable; only its identity and format are wrong.
No parser was invoked: because the identity gate failed before derivation, binary content was never interpreted.
requiredRuling: Decide which DFT identity is authoritative for TM109 before any re-dispatch; a re-dispatch with the same pinned hash will fail identically.
